item.title: OCA/web
item.description:
Odoo web client UI related addons

web

web

Available addons

addon version maintainers summary
web_calendar_slot_duration 19.0.1.0.0 Customizable calendar slot durations
web_chatter_position 19.0.1.0.1 Add an option to change the chatter position
web_company_color 19.0.1.0.1 Web Company Color
web_company_context_highlight 19.0.1.0.0 Highlight the company switcher when multiple companies are selected
web_dark_mode 19.0.1.0.0 Enabled Dark Mode for the Odoo Backend
web_date_format_numeric 19.0.1.0.0 Display all date/datetime fields in numeric format
web_dialog_size 19.0.1.0.2 A module that lets the user expand a dialog box to the full screen width.
web_editor_class_selector 19.0.1.0.0 Web editor class selector
web_environment_ribbon 19.0.1.0.0 Web Environment Ribbon
web_favicon 19.0.1.0.1 Allows to set a custom shortcut icon (aka favicon)
web_filter_header_button 19.0.1.0.0 Show selected filters as buttons in the control panel
web_form_banner 19.0.1.0.0 Show configurable, rule-based alert banners on backend form views
web_group_expand 19.0.1.0.0 Group Expand Buttons
web_ir_actions_act_multi 19.0.1.0.0 Enables triggering of more than one action on ActionManager
web_ir_actions_act_window_message 19.0.1.0.0 Show a message box to users
web_m2x_options 19.0.1.0.1 web_m2x_options
web_m2x_options_manager 19.0.1.0.0 Adds an interface to manage the "Create" and "Create and Edit" options for specific models and fields.
web_no_bubble 19.0.1.0.0 Remove the bubbles from the web interface
web_notify 19.0.1.0.1 Send notification messages to user
web_notify_upgrade 19.0.1.0.0 Notify active users when a module is installed or updated
web_pwa_customize 19.0.1.0.0 Web Pwa Customize
web_quick_start_screen 19.0.1.0.0 Configurable start screen for quick actions
web_refresher 19.0.1.0.1 Web Refresher
web_remember_tree_column_width 19.0.1.0.0 Remember the tree columns' widths across sessions.
web_responsive 19.0.1.1.1 Responsive web client, community-supported
web_search_deactivate_autosearch 19.0.1.0.0 Allow user to deactivate autosearch to add multiple filters
web_search_with_and 19.0.1.0.0 Use AND conditions on omnibar search
web_timeline 19.0.1.0.1 Interactive visualization chart to show events in time
web_tree_many2one_clickable 19.0.1.1.0 Open the linked resource when clicking on their name
web_widget_bokeh_chart 19.0.1.0.1 This widget allows to display charts using Bokeh library.
web_widget_domain_editor_dialog 19.0.1.0.0 Recovers the Domain Editor Dialog functionality
web_widget_dropdown_dynamic 19.0.1.0.0 This module adds support for dynamic dropdown widget
web_widget_numeric_step 19.0.1.0.0 Web Widget Numeric Step
web_widget_one2many_tree_line_duplicate 19.0.1.0.1 Web Widget One2many Tree Line Duplicate
web_widget_popover 19.0.1.0.0 Render an icon that displays the field content in a popover
web_widget_product_label_section_and_note_full_label 19.0.1.0.1 Display the full label in the product_label_section_and_note widget.
web_widget_product_label_section_and_note_name_visibility 19.0.1.0.0 Alternate the visibility of the product and description.
web_widget_section_and_note_text_scrollable 19.0.1.0.0 Make the text field of Section and Note widget scrollable
web_widget_url_advanced 19.0.1.0.0 This module extends URL widget for displaying anchors with custom labels.
web_widget_x2many_2d_matrix 19.0.1.0.0 Show list fields as a matrix

Licenses

This repository is licensed under AGPL-3.0.

However, each module can have a totally different license, as long as they adhere to Odoo Community Association (OCA) policy. Consult each module's __manifest__.py file, which contains a license key that explains its license.

OCA, or the Odoo Community Association, is a nonprofit organization whose mission is to support the collaborative development of Odoo features and promote its widespread use.
